import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1 << 29;
    static final int MAXN = 500;
    static final int MAXQ = 1000000;
    static int n, t, sx, sy;
    static List<Integer>[] g;
    static List<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] d, ptr;
    static int[] tmp;
    static boolean[] passable;
    
    static class Edge {
        int a, b, cap, flow;
        Edge(int a, int b, int cap) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }
    
    static void addEdge(int a, int b, int cap) {
        e.add(new Edge(a, b, cap));
        g[a].add(e.size() - 1);
        e.add(new Edge(b, a, 0));
        g[b].add(e.size() - 1);
    }
    
    static boolean bfs() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(0);
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && d[n * n * 2 + 1] == -1) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int id : g[v]) {
                int to = e.get(id).b;
                if (d[to] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                    q.add(to);
                    d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return d[n * n * 2 + 1] != -1;
    }
    
    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (v == n * n * 2 + 1) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ++ptr[v]) {
            int id = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            int to = e.get(id).b;
            if (d[to] != d[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int maxFlow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(0, INF);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }
    
    static int id(int x, int y) { return x * n + y; }
    
    static int way(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        int[] qx = new int[MAXQ];
        int[] qy = new int[MAXQ];
        int[] qd = new int[MAXQ];
        int head = 0, tail = 0;
        int[] h = new int[n * n];
        Arrays.fill(h, INF);
        
        qx[tail] = x1;
        qy[tail] = y1;
        qd[tail++] = 0;
        
        while (head < tail) {
            int x = qx[head], y = qy[head], v = qd[head++];
            if (v >= h[id(x, y)]) continue;
            h[id(x, y)] = v;
            
            if (x > 0 && passable[id(x - 1, y)] && h[id(x - 1, y)] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x - 1 == x2 && y == y2);
                int lim = tmp[id(x - 1, y)];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1)) {
                    qx[tail] = x - 1;
                    qy[tail] = y;
                    qd[tail++] = v + 1;
                }
            }
            if (y > 0 && passable[id(x, y - 1)] && h[id(x, y - 1)] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x == x2 && y - 1 == y2);
                int lim = tmp[id(x, y - 1)];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1)) {
                    qx[tail] = x;
                    qy[tail] = y - 1;
                    qd[tail++] = v + 1;
                }
            }
            if (x < n - 1 && passable[id(x + 1, y)] && h[id(x + 1, y)] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x + 1 == x2 && y == y2);
                int lim = tmp[id(x + 1, y)];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1)) {
                    qx[tail] = x + 1;
                    qy[tail] = y;
                    qd[tail++] = v + 1;
                }
            }
            if (y < n - 1 && passable[id(x, y + 1)] && h[id(x, y + 1)] > v + 1) {
                boolean target = (x == x2 && y + 1 == y2);
                int lim = tmp[id(x, y + 1)];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1)) {
                    qx[tail] = x;
                    qy[tail] = y + 1;
                    qd[tail++] = v + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return h[id(x2, y2)];
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        tmp = new int[n * n];
        passable = new boolean[n * n];
        g = new ArrayList[n * n * 2 + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n * n * 2 + 2; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        d = new int[n * n * 2 + 2];
        ptr = new int[n * n * 2 + 2];
        e.clear();
        
        Arrays.fill(tmp, t);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        int k = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    passable[id(i, j)] = false;
                } else if (ch == 'Y') {
                    passable[id(i, j)] = false;
                } else {
                    passable[id(i, j)] = true;
                }
                addEdge(0, k++, (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - '0');
            }
        }
        
        k = n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                addEdge(k++, n * n * 2 + 1, (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - '0');
            }
        }
        
        q.add(new int[]{0, sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int v = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];
            if (v >= tmp[id(x, y)]) continue;
            tmp[id(x, y)] = v;
            if (x > 0 && v + 1 < tmp[id(x - 1, y)] && passable[id(x - 1, y)])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x - 1, y});
            if (y > 0 && v + 1 < tmp[id(x, y - 1)] && passable[id(x, y - 1)])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x, y - 1});
            if (x < n - 1 && v + 1 < tmp[id(x + 1, y)] && passable[id(x + 1, y)])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x + 1, y});
            if (y < n - 1 && v + 1 < tmp[id(x, y + 1)] && passable[id(x, y + 1)])
                q.add(new int[]{v + 1, x, y + 1});
        }
        
        k = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int k1 = n * n;
                ++k;
                for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                    for (int w = 0; w < n; w++) {
                        ++k1;
                        if (passable[id(i, j)] && passable[id(z, w)] && way(i, j, z, w) <= t)
                            addEdge(k, k1, INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxFlow());
    }
}
